conditions: Constant-mass nonrelativistic particle in an inertial frame; include work by every force and the change in translational kinetic energy.

evidence: For a constant-mass classical particle, net force is m dv/dt. Dot it with velocity to obtain instantaneous net power equal to d(m v dot v/2)/dt. Integrating over the motion gives the net work equal to final minus initial kinetic energy.
